game-board.label: Game board (/game)
game-board.reason: MEASURED AND WITHDRAWN, on purpose. The walk works (surfaces.ts resumes a match or deals a solo game), but the position it lands on is not fixed, and two consecutive runs of the SAME tree gave cardsOcc 4 then 5 at 844x390x3 — hand-fan overlap scales with the hand. A ceiling that flaps is worse than no ceiling: a lane people learn to re-run is a lane they route around (#2512). The board becomes budgetable through `game-stress` below, which loads a FIXED position; close that row first, then this one.

game-stress.label: Game board — UI stress scenario
game-stress.reason: needs a game the lane created ITSELF (it refuses to load a debug scenario into a match it did not create — that would clobber someone's game) AND the `UI stress — full board, full hand, deep piles` row on the deployment. An active game was in progress when these budgets were recorded. Re-record from an empty lobby: `bun run check:ui -- --record --surface=game-stress`.
